sources.scope: Compatible-agent portable source/Python partial adaptation, not DisCo CLI/model execution or managed import.

construction.method: Stable-ID manual author sequencing plus bounded cache author lane; integrated graph followed by assertion/helper/static and selected pure Python source tests; Apple native blocks retained.

applicability.scope: Selected plugin preparation, KV/offload ownership and speculative/deferred/dispatch evidence investigation. Common catalog scope does not certify CPU inference or cross-backend qualification.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to the plugin-specific platform/ABI, cache-lifecycle and qualification contracts; actual engine changes require separate authority, resource ownership, frozen gates and cleanup, with a supported artifact pairing.
applicability.input_contract: Source/package/runtime/native artifact identities, Python/OS/chip/device, backend/executor, checkpoint/tokenizer/draft identities, format/dtype, effective feature flags and workload.
applicability.produced_artifact: An identity/route/invariant report with actual safe-check result, counter-signal and next authorized native check; partial CPU evidence stays separate from unverified transfers, sleep/wake, model and HTTP outcomes.
applicability.failure_modes: Using lazy import success as native registration or ABI evidence, treating a feature switch as dispatch, or conflating cache capacity with physical residency and kernel time with HTTP time can overstate plugin behavior.

limitations: BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND: actual Apple MLX/Metal and MPS kernels/model loading, cache transfers/sleep/wake and real worker dispatch are not verified.

Installed pure API inspection and selected parser/default tests do not establish a healthy inference dependency set: pip check failed missing requirements, a FastAPI mismatch and unsupported host platform.
No model payload authentication, numerical/model quality, physical memory fit, HTTP service/performance or broad skill efficacy validation.
Detailed GGUF/AWQ/quantization/MoE, DFlash/DSpark, multimodal, diffusion, STT/pooling/LoRA and distributed paths remain bounded route evidence or explicit long-tail gaps.
NO_LICENSE is the actual unauthenticated gh resolver fallback, not legal absence; upstream Apache-2.0 LICENSE retained independently.
recommendations: Resolve platform registration, backend/runner and native ABI pairing before capacity tuning; a package visibility check establishes only its reported software facts.
Keep MLX and MPS, full-attention and recurrent state, logical cache capacity and physical residency as separate contracts.
Preserve failed paths and distinguish parser/API checks from real transfers, sleep/wake, model output and HTTP performance evidence.
